key_domain_differences: Ball observed on 100 pct of frames versus roughly 59 pct in the competition: this corpus does NOT expose a model to the central missing-ball difficulty (Linke et al. found no missing frames in TRACAB Gen5 validation). Dead-ball share 40.7-51.7 pct, much higher than the 19.6 pct in the competition's public 5-minute window. Five of seven matches are Fortuna Dusseldorf home fixtures, so less independent than a count of seven suggests. Stoppage profile measured: ~102 per match, median 19.6 s; 29.7 pct have the SAME team either side, and 42 of them (6 per match) are same-team AND under 10 s - the spell-breakage danger zone. See reports/DeadBallProfile.md
use_and_reproduction_permitted: CC-BY-4.0. Must name the Deutsche Fussball Liga (DFL) and cite Bassek et al. 2025, Scientific Data 12(1) 195
verdict: USE AS THE EVALUATION SET AND THE DEAD-BALL TRUTH. The only open source with genuine frame-level reference labels for both possession and ball status, now confirmed to use the competition's CONTROL convention and validated against the league's own net playing time. Tracking is TRACAB Gen5, 16-20 cameras at 25 Hz, RMSE 0.06-0.18 m.
